summary: Anfield Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing pricing of a US$6.0 million underwritten public offering of 1,491,305 common shares at US$4.00 per share, with an over-allotment option for 223,695 additional shares. The offering, led by Northland Capital Markets and Roth Capital Partners, is expected to close around July 31, 2026, pending TSXV approval. Proceeds fund capital commitments and working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
